items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Me and Poison Humphrey, we'd be playing together like that, on and off, Em and all of us like that. And we decided to make that band strong, you know, just make, organize it like.

ctx.x: Uh, so when did you go into Celestan?

Oh, yeah, I was playing, uh, let me see, then we, Me and Poison Humphrey, we were just working together. Them the fellas I forgot to mention. See, when we'd be living in the field, Me and Poison Humphrey, we'd be playing together like that, on and off, Em and all of us like that. And we decided to make that band strong, you know, just make, organize it like. Yeah. But Sweet Em and Esma, she used it. And the name first was titled from Miss Valente at the paddock.
